rehras|rehras.anand02.line03.simpleEn: The One receives you into protection and helps bring your life’s concerns into order.
rehras|rehras.anand02.line03.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੰਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੇਧ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand02.line03.interpretiveCaution: Divine help in a prayer must not be treated as a guarantee that every worldly plan will succeed automatically.
rehras|rehras.anand02.line03.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand02.line03; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand02.line04.simpleEn: The Lord is capable in every matter; why forget that sustaining Source in your heart?
rehras|rehras.anand02.line04.simplePa: ਉਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਸਮਰੱਥ ਹੈ; ਫਿਰ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਨੋਂ ਕਿਉਂ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਏ?
rehras|rehras.anand02.line04.interpretiveCaution: The rhetorical question encourages remembrance, not abandoning practical responsibility or needed help.
rehras|rehras.anand02.line04.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand02.line04; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand02.line05.simpleEn: Nanak repeats to his own mind: remain with Hari in constant remembrance.
rehras|rehras.anand02.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਣੇ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਮੁੜ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਰਹਿ।
rehras|rehras.anand02.line05.interpretiveCaution: The first and last lines frame a devotional practice, not a continuous attention test or time-based score.
rehras|rehras.anand02.line05.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand02.line05; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand03.line01.simpleEn: O True Sovereign, is anything absent from Your limitless abundance?
rehras|rehras.anand03.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸੱਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ, ਤੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਚੀਜ਼ ਦੀ ਕਮੀ ਹੈ?
rehras|rehras.anand03.line01.interpretiveCaution: A devotional question about the Divine’s fullness, not a statement that all material goods should be available on demand.
rehras|rehras.anand03.line01.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand03.line01; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand03.line02.simpleEn: Your house holds every gift; the one to whom You grant receives.
rehras|rehras.anand03.line02.simplePa: ਤੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਉਹੀ ਪਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand03.line02.interpretiveCaution: The image of a divine house and gifts does not imply that people without resources lack merit or grace.
rehras|rehras.anand03.line02.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand03.line02; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand03.line03.simpleEn: That person continually praises You and keeps Your Naam within the mind.
rehras|rehras.anand03.line03.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਸਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand03.line03.interpretiveCaution: The person receiving the gift in the preceding line remains the subject here. Praise and Naam describe that person’s life; the line is not a separate wish or a new first-person instruction.
rehras|rehras.anand03.line03.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand03.line03; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand03.line04.simpleEn: In minds where Naam dwells, many melodies of joy are pictured as resounding.
rehras|rehras.anand03.line04.simplePa: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਮ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਅੰਦਰ ਮਾਨੋ ਅਨੰਦ ਦੀਆਂ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਰਾਂ ਗੂੰਜਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
rehras|rehras.anand03.line04.interpretiveCaution: Sabada is read here in its musical sense of sounds or melodies. It should not automatically imply a collection of distinct canonical hymns, or require the reader to hear an actual sound.
rehras|rehras.anand03.line04.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand03.line04; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand03.line05.simpleEn: Nanak returns to the wonder of the True Lord’s inexhaustible abundance.
rehras|rehras.anand03.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੜ ਪੁੱਛਦੇ ਹਨ: ਹੇ ਸੱਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ, ਤੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਹੀਂ?
rehras|rehras.anand03.line05.interpretiveCaution: The repeated rhetorical question directs gratitude, not a claim that prayer guarantees wealth or immunity from hardship.
rehras|rehras.anand03.line05.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand03.line05; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand04.line01.simpleEn: The True Naam alone is my enduring support.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line01.simplePa: ਸੱਚਾ ਨਾਮ ਹੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਇਮ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand04.line01.interpretiveCaution: Support is a devotional/metaphorical quality, not an assertion that material responsibilities disappear.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line01.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand04.line01; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand04.line02.simpleEn: That True Naam satisfies a deeper longing that outward cravings could not fill.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line02.simplePa: ਉਹ ਸੱਚਾ ਨਾਮ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਲੀ ਭੁੱਖ ਤੇ ਅਧੂਰੀ ਚਾਹ ਨੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਂਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand04.line02.interpretiveCaution: The word hunger is spiritually figurative and not an instruction to ignore actual food insecurity or hunger.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line02.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand04.line02; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand04.line03.simpleEn: Peace and inner contentment arrive as the Divine comes to dwell in the mind.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line03.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸੇ ਤਾਂ ਸ਼ਾਂਤੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਦੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਬਣਦੀ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand04.line03.interpretiveCaution: This is spiritual wellbeing language, not a clinical treatment guarantee or a promise that every wish is materially fulfilled.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line03.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand04.line03; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand04.line04.simpleEn: I remain deeply grateful to the Guru through whose guidance these gifts were understood.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line04.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਇਹ ਸਮਝ ਅਤੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਿੱਤੀ, ਉਸ ਦਾ ਮੈਂ ਸਦਾ ਸ਼ੁਕਰਗੁਜ਼ਾਰ ਹਾਂ।
rehras|rehras.anand04.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Kurbaan” expresses deep gratitude and devotion, never actual self-harm or coerced transfer of property.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line04.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand04.line04; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand04.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says: listen, seekers, and place loving attention upon the Shabad.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਹੇ ਸੰਤੋ, ਸੁਣੋ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਜੋੜੋ।
rehras|rehras.anand04.line05.interpretiveCaution: The invitation is to attentive living and study, not forced obedience to an unaccountable teacher.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line05.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand04.line05; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand04.line06.simpleEn: The pauri ends as it began: the True Naam is my support.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line06.simplePa: ਪਉੜੀ ਮੁੜ ਕਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ: ਸੱਚਾ ਨਾਮ ਹੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand04.line06.interpretiveCaution: The repetition highlights reliance on Naam, not the replacement of ordinary care, safety or relationships.
rehras|rehras.anand04.line06.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand04.line06; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand05.line01.simpleEn: In that fortunate inner home, a fivefold music of celebration is pictured as resounding.
rehras|rehras.anand05.line01.simplePa: ਉਸ ਸੁਭਾਗੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ-ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਨੋ ਪੰਜ ਕਿਸਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਧੁਨ ਵੱਜਦੀ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand05.line01.interpretiveCaution: Panch sabad is read here as five kinds of musical sounds. This musical image is distinct from the five disruptive impulses in line three; neither five particular hymns nor five audible tones are prescribed.
rehras|rehras.anand05.line01.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand05.line01; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand05.line02.simpleEn: That fortunate inner dwelling is pictured as filled with Shabad, sustained by Divine power.
rehras|rehras.anand05.line02.simplePa: ਉਸ ਸੁਭਾਗੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ-ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵੱਜਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਰੱਬੀ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand05.line02.interpretiveCaution: The “house” is an inward metaphor, not an address, building or price-based spiritual status.
rehras|rehras.anand05.line02.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand05.line02; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand05.line03.simpleEn: The five harmful impulses are subdued and the thorn of death or fear is overcome in the poem’s image.
rehras|rehras.anand05.line03.simplePa: ਪੰਜ ਵਿਕਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਦੇ ਕੰਡੇ ਨੂੰ ਹਰਾਇਆ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand05.line03.interpretiveCaution: The traditional five impulses often refer to lust, anger, greed, attachment and ego. Conquering death is devotional imagery, NOT a medical promise of immortality.
rehras|rehras.anand05.line03.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand05.line03; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand05.line04.simpleEn: Those blessed through Divine grace become joined to Hari’s Naam.
rehras|rehras.anand05.line04.simplePa: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਧੁਰੋਂ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਈ, ਉਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ।
rehras|rehras.anand05.line04.interpretiveCaution: Grace and remembrance should not become a test of someone’s worth, illness or social rank.
rehras|rehras.anand05.line04.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand05.line04; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand05.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says there is profound peace in that inner home, where unstruck Shabad is heard.
rehras|rehras.anand05.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਉਸ ਅੰਦਰਲੇ ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੁਖ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਦੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਗੂੰਜਦੀ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand05.line05.interpretiveCaution: Anhad is spiritual/musical metaphor and does not verify an audible frequency, noise hallucination or recording.
rehras|rehras.anand05.line05.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand05.line05; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand40.line01.simpleEn: Listen, blessed ones, to this Anand; the heart’s longings are pictured as fulfilled.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਓ, ਇਹ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੁਣੋ; ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ-ਭਰੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand40.line01.interpretiveCaution: Statements of illness disappearing are religious/devotional language, not clinical efficacy data, and should not be used to dissuade anyone from medical treatment.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line01.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand40.line01; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand40.line02.simpleEn: Finding the Transcendent Divine, the poem says, removes deep anxieties and grief.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line02.simplePa: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਨਾਲ ਮਨ ਦੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ਦੂਰ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand40.line02.interpretiveCaution: Statements of illness disappearing are religious/devotional language, not clinical efficacy data, and should not be used to dissuade anyone from medical treatment.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line02.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand40.line02; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand40.line03.simpleEn: Suffering, illness and burning distress are described as lifted by hearing the true Bani.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line03.simplePa: ਸੱਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਨ ਨਾਲ ਦੁੱਖ, ਰੋਗ ਤੇ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਦੂਰ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਧਾਰਮਿਕ ਅਸੀਸ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand40.line03.interpretiveCaution: Statements of illness disappearing are religious/devotional language, not clinical efficacy data, and should not be used to dissuade anyone from medical treatment.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line03.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand40.line03; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand40.line04.simpleEn: Saintly companions become joyful, receiving understanding through the Perfect Guru.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line04.simplePa: ਸੰਤ ਤੇ ਸੱਜਣ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਸੂਝ ਪਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
rehras|rehras.anand40.line04.interpretiveCaution: Statements of illness disappearing are religious/devotional language, not clinical efficacy data, and should not be used to dissuade anyone from medical treatment.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line04.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand40.line04; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand40.line05.simpleEn: Listening and speaking this Bani are praised as purifying because the True Guru is fully present.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line05.simplePa: ਇਸ ਬਾਣੀ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਣਨਾ ਤੇ ਕਹਿਣਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਰਬ-ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand40.line05.interpretiveCaution: Statements of illness disappearing are religious/devotional language, not clinical efficacy data, and should not be used to dissuade anyone from medical treatment.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line05.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand40.line05; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.anand40.line06.simpleEn: Nanak bows at the Guru’s feet, while the unstruck trumpets of joy resound in the poem.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line06.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜ ਕੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਵਾਲੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ।
rehras|rehras.anand40.line06.interpretiveCaution: Statements of illness disappearing are religious/devotional language, not clinical efficacy data, and should not be used to dissuade anyone from medical treatment.
rehras|rehras.anand40.line06.sourceContext: REUSED_ONLY_AFTER_EXACT_SOURCE_SHA_MATCH; anand|anand40.line06; sggs witness; separate Rehras occurrence id

rehras|rehras.sggs01.line01.simpleEn: Source heading: So Dar in Raag Aasa, Mahala 1, opens under the invocation of the One through the Guru’s grace.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line01.simplePa: ਸਿਰਲੇਖ: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ, ਰਾਗ ਆਸਾ, ਮਹਲਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ; ਇੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਤੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਨਾਲ ਆਰੰਭ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line01.interpretiveCaution: These long frozen original source records each contain several original tuks. All accompanying text is a topical passage summary, not an approved literal translation. Mythic beings and cosmic “singing” are devotional imagery, not historical or scientific measurements.

rehras|rehras.sggs01.line02.simpleEn: The poet wonders at the Divine court and home, where countless sounds, raags and singers join the praise; even wind, water, fire and moral order are pictured singing.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line02.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਦਰਬਾਰ ਦਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ; ਅਣਗਿਣਤ ਨਾਦ, ਰਾਗ ਤੇ ਗਾਇਕ, ਪਵਣ, ਪਾਣੀ, ਅੱਗ ਅਤੇ ਧਰਮ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਜੁੜੇ ਦਿਖਦੇ ਹਨ।
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line02.interpretiveCaution: These long frozen original source records each contain several original tuks. All accompanying text is a topical passage summary, not an approved literal translation. Mythic beings and cosmic “singing” are devotional imagery, not historical or scientific measurements.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line02.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs01.line03.simpleEn: Traditional recorders of deeds, Brahma, Shiva, Indra, siddhs and seekers all join this vast hymn of Divine praise.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line03.simplePa: ਧਰਮ ਦੇ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੁਰਾਣਕ ਪਾਤਰ, ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ, ਸ਼ਿਵ, ਇੰਦਰ, ਸਿੱਧ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਧਕ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰਦੇ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line03.interpretiveCaution: These long frozen original source records each contain several original tuks. All accompanying text is a topical passage summary, not an approved literal translation. Mythic beings and cosmic “singing” are devotional imagery, not historical or scientific measurements.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line03.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs01.line04.simpleEn: Ascetics, truthful people, scholars, enchanting beings, created jewels and holy places are all portrayed as part of creation’s praise.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line04.simplePa: ਜਤੀ-ਸਤੀ, ਸੰਤੋਖੀ, ਪੰਡਿਤ, ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰਚਨਾਵਾਂ, ਰਤਨ ਅਤੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਾਰੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਾਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line04.interpretiveCaution: These long frozen original source records each contain several original tuks. All accompanying text is a topical passage summary, not an approved literal translation. Mythic beings and cosmic “singing” are devotional imagery, not historical or scientific measurements.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line04.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs01.line05.simpleEn: Warriors, living beings and worlds beyond counting offer praise; those who please the One are absorbed in devotion, while the poet admits that the full number cannot be named.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line05.simplePa: ਸੂਰਮੇ, ਜੀਵ ਤੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਲੋਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ; ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਲ ਰੰਗੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਕਵੀ ਸਭ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਤੋਂ ਅਸਮਰੱਥਤਾ ਮੰਨਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line05.interpretiveCaution: These long frozen original source records each contain several original tuks. All accompanying text is a topical passage summary, not an approved literal translation. Mythic beings and cosmic “singing” are devotional imagery, not historical or scientific measurements.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line05.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs01.line06.simpleEn: The One true Lord remains through time, creates many forms and observes them, and the poet ends by counselling acceptance of Divine Hukam.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line06.simplePa: ਸੱਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਇਮ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪ ਰਚਦਾ ਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਹੈ; ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਜ਼ਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿਣ ਦੀ ਸੇਧ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ।
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line06.interpretiveCaution: These long frozen original source records each contain several original tuks. All accompanying text is a topical passage summary, not an approved literal translation. Mythic beings and cosmic “singing” are devotional imagery, not historical or scientific measurements.
rehras|rehras.sggs01.line06.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs02.line01.simpleEn: Everyone calls the Lord great, yet no one can fully measure or price that greatness; the refrain praises the deep, generous Sovereign beyond counting.
rehras|rehras.sggs02.line01.simplePa: ਸਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਡਾ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੋਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈਂਦਾ; ਰਹਾਉ ਅਥਾਹ ਗੁਣਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs02.line01.interpretiveCaution: This source record combines multiple tuks and numbered sub-stanzas; the note is an attributed educational summary, not a tuk-by-tuk literal translation. The Great One is not a calculable object.
rehras|rehras.sggs02.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs02.line02.simpleEn: Even gathered sages, meditators and virtuous practitioners cannot exhaust the One’s glory; spiritual accomplishment is received through grace, and Nanak remembers the inexhaustible truth.
rehras|rehras.sggs02.line02.simplePa: ਗਿਆਨੀ, ਧਿਆਨੀ ਤੇ ਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਵਾਲੇ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਦੇ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਸੇਧ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਅਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੱਚ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
rehras|rehras.sggs02.line02.interpretiveCaution: This source record combines multiple tuks and numbered sub-stanzas; the note is an attributed educational summary, not a tuk-by-tuk literal translation. The Great One is not a calculable object.
rehras|rehras.sggs02.line02.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs03.line01.simpleEn: The speaker lives through naming the True One and feels separation as spiritual death; the hunger for Naam helps put troubles into perspective, while the refrain asks why the mind forgets the True Lord.
rehras|rehras.sggs03.line01.simplePa: ਸੱਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਦਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਵਿਸਾਰਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਲੀ ਮੌਤ ਵਰਗਾ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ; ਨਾਮ ਦੀ ਭੁੱਖ ਦੁੱਖ ਤੋਂ ਰਾਹ ਦਿਖਾਉਂਦੀ ਅਤੇ ਰਹਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਾ ਭੁੱਲਣ ਦੀ ਸੇਧ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs03.line01.interpretiveCaution: Words about dying when remembrance is lost or suffering leaving are devotional metaphors, not clinical claims or a basis for judging caste or human dignity. Multiple original source tuks are summarized together.
rehras|rehras.sggs03.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs03.line02.simpleEn: The Divine does not die or exhaust its giving; the Creator of day and night is praised as the true support, and forgetting Naam is condemned as spiritual disregard.
rehras|rehras.sggs03.line02.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਣ ਤੇ ਦਾਤ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ; ਦਿਨ-ਰਾਤ ਦੇ ਰਚਨਹਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਅਸਲ ਸਹਾਰਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸਾਰਨ ਨੂੰ ਡੂੰਘੀ ਭੁੱਲ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs03.line02.interpretiveCaution: Words about dying when remembrance is lost or suffering leaving are devotional metaphors, not clinical claims or a basis for judging caste or human dignity. Multiple original source tuks are summarized together.
rehras|rehras.sggs03.line02.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs04.line01.simpleEn: With profound humility the speaker approaches the True Guru, asking for the light of Naam; the refrain calls Naam a companion of life and Hari’s praise the true evening Rahras.
rehras|rehras.sggs04.line01.simplePa: ਨਿਮਰਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਆ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਚਾਨਣ ਮੰਗਿਆ ਹੈ; ਰਹਾਉ ਨਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਜੀਵਨ ਦਾ ਸਾਥੀ ਅਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੀ ਕੀਰਤ ਨੂੰ ਰਹਿਰਾਸਿ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs04.line01.interpretiveCaution: Words about those outside sangat are the source poem’s devotional exhortation, not a right to stigmatize anyone. This is a multi-tuk source record summary.
rehras|rehras.sggs04.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs04.line02.simpleEn: The blessing of trusting Hari and joining the sangat is celebrated, while estrangement from Naam is pictured as a wasted opportunity; the hymn ends by praising the transformative sangat.
rehras|rehras.sggs04.line02.simplePa: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲ ਸ਼ਰਧਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਗਤ ਦੇ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੈ; ਨਾਮ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਆਇਆ ਮੌਕਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ, ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਤਸੰਗਤ ਦਾ ਧੰਨਵਾਦ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs04.line02.interpretiveCaution: Words about those outside sangat are the source poem’s devotional exhortation, not a right to stigmatize anyone. This is a multi-tuk source record summary.
rehras|rehras.sggs04.line02.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs05.line01.simpleEn: The mind is asked why it worries constantly about provision when the One sustains even creatures among stones; the refrain recalls the uplifting presence of the sangat and Guru’s grace.
rehras|rehras.sggs05.line01.simplePa: ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਪੁੱਛਿਆ ਕਿ ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਿਉਂ ਜਕੜਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਦ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪੱਥਰਾਂ ਵਿਚਲੇ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਵੀ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਰਹਾਉ ਸੰਗਤ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs05.line01.interpretiveCaution: The source’s sustaining-care imagery must never mean “do not work, feed your children, seek care or plan for rent.” Animal behaviour in the verse is devotional illustration, not modern biological evidence.
rehras|rehras.sggs05.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs05.line02.simpleEn: The One sustains people and creatures beyond what family members alone can provide; birds and their young become images of care, ending in gratitude for Divine gifts without limit.
rehras|rehras.sggs05.line02.simplePa: ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਵੀ ਵੱਡਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਯਾਦ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ; ਦੂਰ ਉੱਡਦੇ ਪੰਛੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਦਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਸ਼ੁਕਰਾਨਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs05.line02.interpretiveCaution: The source’s sustaining-care imagery must never mean “do not work, feed your children, seek care or plan for rent.” Animal behaviour in the verse is devotional illustration, not modern biological evidence.
rehras|rehras.sggs05.line02.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs06.line01.simpleEn: So Purakh begins by praising the pure, boundless One whom all living beings remember, the Creator and sustainer of every life; Hari is depicted as both sovereign and present with devotees.
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line01.simplePa: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਤੇ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਆਖਿਆ ਹੈ; ਸਾਰੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਦੇ ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਹਾਰਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line01.interpretiveCaution: Source records combine several SGGS tuks. Statements about release from death and universal divine presence are theological poetry, not medical or scientific claims. Preserve the five-part source order.
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs06.line02.simpleEn: The One pervades every heart; the poem sees giver and receiver alike within the Divine play, praising a Reality too vast for any one person to describe.
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line02.simplePa: ਇੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰ ਘਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈ; ਦਾਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਤਾ ਉਸੇ ਦੇ ਖੇਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਨ, ਉਸ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਬਿਆਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ।
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line02.interpretiveCaution: Source records combine several SGGS tuks. Statements about release from death and universal divine presence are theological poetry, not medical or scientific claims. Preserve the five-part source order.
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line02.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs06.line03.simpleEn: Those who remember the Fearless One are praised as finding peace and freedom from bondage to death and fear, and the devotee gives thanks for such remembrance.
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line03.simplePa: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਨਾਲ ਸੁਖ, ਡਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਦੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਂ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਦੀ ਆਤਮਕ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਹੈ; ਭਗਤ ਇਸ ਦਾਤ ਲਈ ਸਦਕੇ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line03.interpretiveCaution: Source records combine several SGGS tuks. Statements about release from death and universal divine presence are theological poetry, not medical or scientific claims. Preserve the five-part source order.
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line03.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs06.line04.simpleEn: Many people praise through devotion, worship, study, austerity and traditional practices; the poem honours those who are sincerely dear to the One.
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line04.simplePa: ਅਨੇਕ ਭਗਤ, ਪੂਜਾ, ਪਾਠ ਤੇ ਤਪਸਿਆ ਦੇ ਢੰਗਾਂ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਹੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੱਚੇ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line04.interpretiveCaution: Source records combine several SGGS tuks. Statements about release from death and universal divine presence are theological poetry, not medical or scientific claims. Preserve the five-part source order.
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line04.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs06.line05.simpleEn: The One eternal Creator remains through all ages, brings forth and withdraws the creation, and Nanak sings of the Lord who knows everyone.
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line05.simplePa: ਇੱਕੋ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਜੁਗਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਅਡੋਲ ਹੈ; ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਰਚਦਾ ਤੇ ਸਮੇਟਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਣਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line05.interpretiveCaution: Source records combine several SGGS tuks. Statements about release from death and universal divine presence are theological poetry, not medical or scientific claims. Preserve the five-part source order.
rehras|rehras.sggs06.line05.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs07.line01.simpleEn: You are the truthful Creator and Sovereign; all belongs to You, Naam is received through grace, and the river-like Divine holds creation and the changing meetings of living beings.
rehras|rehras.sggs07.line01.simplePa: ਤੂੰ ਸੱਚਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਹੈਂ; ਸਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ, ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਨਾਮ-ਰਤਨ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਦਰਿਆ ਵਰਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਵਿੱਚ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਿਲਾਪ-ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਦਾ ਖੇਲ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs07.line01.interpretiveCaution: The river and encounters/separations are devotional imagery. Hukam must not be used to excuse harmful human conduct or deny responsibility. These long records are summaries of multiple original tuks.
rehras|rehras.sggs07.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs07.line02.simpleEn: Only those You make understand can know You; the hymn celebrates Hari’s virtues, natural peace and the Guru-oriented recognition that the Creator does everything.
rehras|rehras.sggs07.line02.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੂਝ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਉਹੀ ਪਛਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ, ਸਹਜ ਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਅਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਜੀਵਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs07.line02.interpretiveCaution: The river and encounters/separations are devotional imagery. Hukam must not be used to excuse harmful human conduct or deny responsibility. These long records are summaries of multiple original tuks.
rehras|rehras.sggs07.line02.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs08.line01.simpleEn: The hymn pictures life in a pool whose water burns with craving, with feet caught in the mud of attachment; the refrain calls the forgetful mind back to the One, and the speaker seeks those who keep the Divine in remembrance.
rehras|rehras.sggs08.line01.simplePa: ਜੀਵਨ ਨੂੰ ਅਜਿਹੇ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਨਾਲ ਜੋੜਿਆ ਹੈ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਦੀ ਅੱਗ ਅਤੇ ਮੋਹ ਦਾ ਚਿੱਕੜ ਪੈਰ ਰੋਕਦੇ ਹਨ; ਰਹਾਉ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਵੱਲ ਮੋੜਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਾ ਭੁੱਲਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਮੰਗੀ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs08.line01.interpretiveCaution: The consulted readings understand pank ju moh as the mud of attachment in this sentence, not a lotus. The frozen source spelling is unchanged. Fire, mud and drowning describe spiritual entanglement; this full-hymn summary is not a diagnosis or a literal account of a physical event.
rehras|rehras.sggs08.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.sggs09.line01.simpleEn: Human birth is described as an opportunity to meet Gobind through Naam and the sangat; the hymn urges the mind not to lose that opportunity in attachment and ends in a humble request for protection.
rehras|rehras.sggs09.line01.simplePa: ਮਨੁੱਖਾ ਜਨਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਦਾ ਮੌਕਾ ਹੈ; ਨਾਮ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜ ਕੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਮੋਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੌਕਾ ਨਾ ਗੁਆਉਣ ਦੀ ਸੇਧ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.sggs09.line01.interpretiveCaution: Human worth is not a performance score and this poem never authorizes judging someone who cannot attend sangat or has a disability. The source record contains multiple tuks, not a single translated line.
rehras|rehras.sggs09.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.savaiya01.line01.simpleEn: The poet takes refuge at the Divine feet, declining to make another ultimate refuge; Rama, Rahim and named scriptural traditions appear in a strong comparison that ends by attributing the words spoken to Asipan’s grace.
rehras|rehras.savaiya01.line01.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਹੋਰ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਆਸਰਾ ਨਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਰਾਮ-ਰਹੀਮ ਤੇ ਧਾਰਮਿਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥਾਂ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਕਰਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਹੇ ਬਚਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਿਹਰਾ ਅਸਿਪਾਨ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨੂੰ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.savaiya01.line01.interpretiveCaution: This is the evening Pae Gahe Savaiya, distinct from the ten morning Sravag Sudh verses. Its closing credits Divine grace for the utterance, rather than merely asking for future grace. The strong comparison of traditions does not authorize contempt for their believers; this is a summary of multiple tuks.
rehras|rehras.savaiya01.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; dasam family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.dohira01.line01.simpleEn: Leaving every other doorway, the poet seeks the Divine doorway and asks the One to honour the protection of a servant who has grasped that refuge.
rehras|rehras.dohira01.line01.simplePa: ਹੋਰ ਸਭ ਦਰ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ ਕਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਦਰ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਬਾਂਹ ਫੜੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੀ ਲਾਜ ਰੱਖ।
rehras|rehras.dohira01.line01.interpretiveCaution: Traditional martial/servant imagery expresses devotional refuge; not obedience to a human authority, literal rejection of all practical help or a promise of physical invulnerability. This is an evening Dohira, not the morning Savaiye.
rehras|rehras.dohira01.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; dasam family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.mundawani.line01.simpleEn: In the poetic platter lie truth, contentment and reflective understanding, together with the nourishing Naam of the Lord; those who receive and live this gift are pictured as crossing worldly darkness.
rehras|rehras.mundawani.line01.simplePa: ਰੂਪਕ ਵਾਲੇ ਥਾਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਤ, ਸੰਤੋਖ ਤੇ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਿੰਨ ਵਸਤਾਂ ਹਨ; ਹਰਿ ਦਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮ ਸਹਾਰਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਸਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੋਂ ਪਾਰ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਸੇਧ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.mundawani.line01.interpretiveCaution: Mundawani uses a food/platter metaphor for qualities of a lived spiritual practice, not an actual edible cure or promise of material goods. Source is SGGS Mahala 5.
rehras|rehras.mundawani.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

rehras|rehras.slok.line01.simpleEn: The speaker admits that the Divine gifts cannot be fully understood, expresses humility and gratitude for compassion and the True Guru, and describes Naam as bringing renewed life to body and mind.
rehras|rehras.slok.line01.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਮੰਨਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀਆਂ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਮਝੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ; ਨਿਮਰਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਸ਼ੁਕਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਮਨ-ਤਨ ਦੀ ਹਰਿਆਵਲ ਦਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.slok.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Life and greening of body/mind” is devotional renewal, not a claim of treatment efficacy for illness. The slok belongs to SGGS Mahala 5 and must stay separate from Dasam source passages.
rehras|rehras.slok.line01.sourceContext: REHRAS_ORIGINAL_AGGREGATED_TUK_RECORD; sggs family; summary not literal per-tuk translation

jaap|jaap001.line03.simpleEn: The One is described as unchanging, self-radiant and of immeasurable splendour.
jaap|jaap001.line03.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਅਡੋਲ, ਆਪ-ਪਰਕਾਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਅਥਾਹ ਤੇਜ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap001.line03.interpretiveCaution: Indra, the three worlds and “neti-neti” belong to traditional poetic/philosophical vocabulary, not measurable celestial rankings or a modern scientific model. This original six-line first Chhand is not the same as a six-line Japji pauri.

jaap|jaap001.line04.simpleEn: Even countless Indras and sovereigns cannot match the sovereignty attributed to the One.
jaap|jaap001.line04.simplePa: ਕ੍ਰੋੜਾਂ ਇੰਦਰਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਵੀ ਉੱਚਾ ਉਸ ਇੱਕ ਦਾ ਰੁਤਬਾ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap001.line04.interpretiveCaution: Indra, the three worlds and “neti-neti” belong to traditional poetic/philosophical vocabulary, not measurable celestial rankings or a modern scientific model. This original six-line first Chhand is not the same as a six-line Japji pauri.

jaap|jaap001.line05.simpleEn: The three worlds, divine beings, humans, traditional adversaries, forests and grass all fall short of describing the One’s full extent.
jaap|jaap001.line05.simplePa: ਤਿੰਨ ਲੋਕ, ਦੇਵਤੇ, ਮਨੁੱਖ, ਪੁਰਾਣਕ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ, ਜੰਗਲ ਤੇ ਘਾਹ ਤਕ ਉਸ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਵਰਣਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ।
jaap|jaap001.line05.interpretiveCaution: Indra, the three worlds and “neti-neti” belong to traditional poetic/philosophical vocabulary, not measurable celestial rankings or a modern scientific model. This original six-line first Chhand is not the same as a six-line Japji pauri.

jaap|jaap001.line06.simpleEn: Who could tell all Your names? The poet turns to action-related Divine names and the limits of understanding.
jaap|jaap001.line06.simplePa: ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੌਣ ਗਿਣ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ? ਕਵੀ ਕਰਮ-ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਵੱਲ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap001.line06.interpretiveCaution: Indra, the three worlds and “neti-neti” belong to traditional poetic/philosophical vocabulary, not measurable celestial rankings or a modern scientific model. This original six-line first Chhand is not the same as a six-line Japji pauri.

jaap|jaap003.line01.simpleEn: Salutation to the One not confined to any visible costume, costume-based identity or outer appearance.
jaap|jaap003.line01.simplePa: ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜੋ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਭੇਖ ਜਾਂ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੱਝਦਾ।
jaap|jaap003.line01.interpretiveCaution: The source epithets Abhekh, Alekh, Akay and Ajay are Sanskrit/Braj-derived and require exact philological review; devotional “beyond body” is not an instruction to disdain human bodies.

jaap|jaap003.line02.simpleEn: Salutation to the One beyond being fully written, numbered or exhaustively described.
jaap|jaap003.line02.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਜਾਂ ਵਰਣਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap003.line02.interpretiveCaution: The source epithets Abhekh, Alekh, Akay and Ajay are Sanskrit/Braj-derived and require exact philological review; devotional “beyond body” is not an instruction to disdain human bodies.

jaap|jaap003.line03.simpleEn: Salutation to the One not confined to a limited material body.
jaap|jaap003.line03.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜੋ ਕਿਸੇ ਸੀਮਤ ਸਰੀਰ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap003.line03.interpretiveCaution: The source epithets Abhekh, Alekh, Akay and Ajay are Sanskrit/Braj-derived and require exact philological review; devotional “beyond body” is not an instruction to disdain human bodies.

jaap|jaap003.line04.simpleEn: Salutation to the birthless One, beyond coming into existence in an ordinary way.
jaap|jaap003.line04.simplePa: ਉਸ ਅਜਨਮੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜੋ ਆਮ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap003.line04.interpretiveCaution: The source epithets Abhekh, Alekh, Akay and Ajay are Sanskrit/Braj-derived and require exact philological review; devotional “beyond body” is not an instruction to disdain human bodies.

jaap|jaap004.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the One who cannot be vanquished or worn down by hostile forces.
jaap|jaap004.line01.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜੋ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੈਰ ਜਾਂ ਜ਼ੋਰ ਨਾਲ ਨਾਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ।
jaap|jaap004.line01.interpretiveCaution: The source “Athame” and “Aname” need Braj/Sanskrit review; “unbreakable” is religious praise, not a guarantee of physical protection for the reader.

jaap|jaap004.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One whose reality cannot be broken or shattered.
jaap|jaap004.line02.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਭੰਨਿਆ ਜਾਂ ਟੁੱਟਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap004.line02.interpretiveCaution: The source “Athame” and “Aname” need Braj/Sanskrit review; “unbreakable” is religious praise, not a guarantee of physical protection for the reader.

jaap|jaap004.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One not limited by one humanly assigned name.
jaap|jaap004.line03.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਰੱਖੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਨਾਮ ਤਕ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap004.line03.interpretiveCaution: The source “Athame” and “Aname” need Braj/Sanskrit review; “unbreakable” is religious praise, not a guarantee of physical protection for the reader.

jaap|jaap004.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One not contained within a single fixed place or dwelling.
jaap|jaap004.line04.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਇੱਕੋ ਨਿਸ਼ਚਿਤ ਠਿਕਾਣਾ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap004.line04.interpretiveCaution: The source “Athame” and “Aname” need Braj/Sanskrit review; “unbreakable” is religious praise, not a guarantee of physical protection for the reader.

jaap|jaap005.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the One beyond the limits of ordinary actions or karmic obligation.
jaap|jaap005.line01.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜੋ ਆਮ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਬੰਧਨ-ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap005.line01.interpretiveCaution: Akarm and Adharm are easily misread; their theological use does NOT authorize immoral conduct, avoidance of responsibility or a claim that moral duties are meaningless. Human review mandatory.

jaap|jaap005.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One beyond humanly defined religious duty; this is not a claim that the One is immoral.
jaap|jaap005.line02.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖੀ ਧਰਮ-ਵਰਗਾਂ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ; ਇਸ ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਅਧਰਮੀ ਹੋਣਾ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap005.line02.interpretiveCaution: Akarm and Adharm are easily misread; their theological use does NOT authorize immoral conduct, avoidance of responsibility or a claim that moral duties are meaningless. Human review mandatory.

jaap|jaap005.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One who cannot be contained in any one humanly given title.
jaap|jaap005.line03.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਹੀ ਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap005.line03.interpretiveCaution: Akarm and Adharm are easily misread; their theological use does NOT authorize immoral conduct, avoidance of responsibility or a claim that moral duties are meaningless. Human review mandatory.

jaap|jaap005.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One not confined to a fixed building, location or abode.
jaap|jaap005.line04.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜੋ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਘਰ ਜਾਂ ਠਿਕਾਣੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap005.line04.interpretiveCaution: Akarm and Adharm are easily misread; their theological use does NOT authorize immoral conduct, avoidance of responsibility or a claim that moral duties are meaningless. Human review mandatory.

jaap|jaap006.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the One who cannot be conquered by worldly power.
jaap|jaap006.line01.simplePa: ਉਸ ਅਜਿੱਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੀ ਕੋਈ ਤਾਕਤ ਜਿੱਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦੀ।
jaap|jaap006.line01.interpretiveCaution: Abaha and Adhaha spellings are not adjudicated. The martial images praise the Divine; they do not instruct readers to be violent or promise invulnerability.

jaap|jaap006.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the Fearless One, not ruled by fear of another.
jaap|jaap006.line02.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜੋ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਤੋਂ ਡਰਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap006.line02.interpretiveCaution: Abaha and Adhaha spellings are not adjudicated. The martial images praise the Divine; they do not instruct readers to be violent or promise invulnerability.

jaap|jaap006.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the steadfast One, whom nothing can displace.
jaap|jaap006.line03.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਅਡੋਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਹਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap006.line03.interpretiveCaution: For Abahe, this working reading follows the movement-related root explained in the consulted commentary. The earlier reference to bodily arms was unsupported; the original spelling is unchanged.

jaap|jaap006.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One who cannot be pulled down or demolished.
jaap|jaap006.line04.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਢਾਹਿਆ ਜਾਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੁੱਟਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap006.line04.interpretiveCaution: Abaha and Adhaha spellings are not adjudicated. The martial images praise the Divine; they do not instruct readers to be violent or promise invulnerability.

jaap|jaap007.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the One described as beyond limiting colour or stain; the exact Anile gloss remains provisional.
jaap|jaap007.line01.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜੋ ਸੀਮਤ ਰੰਗ ਜਾਂ ਮੈਲ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ; “ਅਨੀਲੇ” ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਹਾਲੇ ਅਸਥਾਈ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap007.line01.interpretiveCaution: The Anile epithet is especially sensitive to source vowels and Braj morphology; never silently equate it with a skin-colour judgment or literal anatomy.

jaap|jaap007.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One who has no ordinary beginning.
jaap|jaap007.line02.simplePa: ਉਸ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਆਮ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap007.line02.interpretiveCaution: The Anile epithet is especially sensitive to source vowels and Braj morphology; never silently equate it with a skin-colour judgment or literal anatomy.

jaap|jaap007.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One who cannot be severed or cut apart.
jaap|jaap007.line03.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਕੱਟ ਕੇ ਵੱਖਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap007.line03.interpretiveCaution: The Anile epithet is especially sensitive to source vowels and Braj morphology; never silently equate it with a skin-colour judgment or literal anatomy.

jaap|jaap007.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One whose depths cannot be reached or fully understood.
jaap|jaap007.line04.simplePa: ਉਸ ਅਥਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap007.line04.interpretiveCaution: The Anile epithet is especially sensitive to source vowels and Braj morphology; never silently equate it with a skin-colour judgment or literal anatomy.

jaap|jaap008.line01.simpleEn: I bow once again to the One beyond defeat or destruction.
jaap|jaap008.line01.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਮੁੜ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਨਾਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap008.line01.interpretiveCaution: Agange/Abhanje are deliberately repeated from Chhand4; Udare and Apare add generosity and immeasurability. Do not claim an approved literal Braj morphology or worldly gift guarantee.

jaap|jaap008.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One who cannot be broken into parts.
jaap|jaap008.line02.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਭੰਨਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap008.line02.interpretiveCaution: Agange/Abhanje are deliberately repeated from Chhand4; Udare and Apare add generosity and immeasurability. Do not claim an approved literal Braj morphology or worldly gift guarantee.

jaap|jaap008.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One praised as generous and open-handed in blessing.
jaap|jaap008.line03.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਉਦਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap008.line03.interpretiveCaution: Agange/Abhanje are deliberately repeated from Chhand4; Udare and Apare add generosity and immeasurability. Do not claim an approved literal Braj morphology or worldly gift guarantee.

jaap|jaap008.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One who is without a measurable end or boundary.
jaap|jaap008.line04.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap008.line04.interpretiveCaution: Agange/Abhanje are deliberately repeated from Chhand4; Udare and Apare add generosity and immeasurability. Do not claim an approved literal Braj morphology or worldly gift guarantee.

jaap|jaap009.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the One, undivided in its deepest reality.
jaap|jaap009.line01.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਇੱਕੋ ਅਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ।
jaap|jaap009.line01.interpretiveCaution: This juxtaposes One and many; Abhute/Ajupe are working editorial glosses and must not be treated as a definitive doctrine about physical existence.

jaap|jaap009.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One present through countless expressions and forms.
jaap|jaap009.line02.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਅਨੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap009.line02.interpretiveCaution: This juxtaposes One and many; Abhute/Ajupe are working editorial glosses and must not be treated as a definitive doctrine about physical existence.

jaap|jaap009.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One described as beyond the limits of the created/material condition; the exact Abhute sense is provisional.
jaap|jaap009.line03.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਸਿਰਜੀਆਂ ਵਸਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ; “ਅਭੂਤੇ” ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਅਸਥਾਈ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap009.line03.interpretiveCaution: This juxtaposes One and many; Abhute/Ajupe are working editorial glosses and must not be treated as a definitive doctrine about physical existence.

jaap|jaap009.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the unbound One, free from constraint.
jaap|jaap009.line04.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਮੁਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਕਿਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap009.line04.interpretiveCaution: Ajupe is read here as freedom from bondage, supported by the consulted Narain Singh steek. The Bhai Vir Singh-derived commentary connects it with freedom from pain. These readings remain open for specialist comparison; neither makes Ajupe simply another word for formlessness.

jaap|jaap010.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the One not held captive by ordinary karma or the bonds of actions.
jaap|jaap010.line01.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਆਮ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap010.line01.interpretiveCaution: Nrikarme/Nribharme/Nrideshe/Nribheshe use old negative prefixes and spellings; meanings are draft working paraphrases, not pronunciation or lexical certification.

jaap|jaap010.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One free from confusion and deluding uncertainty.
jaap|jaap010.line02.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਭਰਮ ਤੇ ਉਲਝਣ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap010.line02.interpretiveCaution: Nrikarme/Nribharme/Nrideshe/Nribheshe use old negative prefixes and spellings; meanings are draft working paraphrases, not pronunciation or lexical certification.

jaap|jaap010.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One not confined to one geographic direction, country or place.
jaap|jaap010.line03.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਦੇਸ ਜਾਂ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੱਝਦਾ।
jaap|jaap010.line03.interpretiveCaution: Nrikarme/Nribharme/Nrideshe/Nribheshe use old negative prefixes and spellings; meanings are draft working paraphrases, not pronunciation or lexical certification.

jaap|jaap010.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One not defined by costume, dress or external appearance.
jaap|jaap010.line04.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਭੇਖ ਜਾਂ ਬਾਹਰਲੀ ਦਿੱਖ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap010.line04.interpretiveCaution: Nrikarme/Nribharme/Nrideshe/Nribheshe use old negative prefixes and spellings; meanings are draft working paraphrases, not pronunciation or lexical certification.

jaap|jaap011.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the One not confined to a single humanly assigned name.
jaap|jaap011.line01.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਰੱਖੇ ਹੋਏ ਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap011.line01.interpretiveCaution: Nirdhate and Nirghate are difficult Sanskrit/Braj epithets. These are working educational senses only, NOT verified morphological interpretations; no claim of immunity to harm.

jaap|jaap011.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One free from demanding or grasping desire.
jaap|jaap011.line02.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਮੰਗਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap011.line02.interpretiveCaution: Nirdhate and Nirghate are difficult Sanskrit/Braj epithets. These are working educational senses only, NOT verified morphological interpretations; no claim of immunity to harm.

jaap|jaap011.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One not made from bodily elements.
jaap|jaap011.line03.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਸਰੀਰ ਦੇ ਤੱਤਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਣਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap011.line03.interpretiveCaution: Nirdhate is related here to dhatu, the constituents of a body. This is a theological working gloss, not a scientific claim about matter. The earlier wording about dependence or support confused this epithet with a different idea.

jaap|jaap011.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One beyond injury or defeat; the precise “Nirghate” lexical form remains unsettled.
jaap|jaap011.line04.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਨਾਸ ਜਾਂ ਘਾਤ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ; “ਨ੍ਰਿਘਾਤੇ” ਦਾ ਪੱਕਾ ਅਰਥ ਹਾਲੇ ਅਣਨਿਰਣਿਤ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap011.line04.interpretiveCaution: Nirdhate and Nirghate are difficult Sanskrit/Braj epithets. These are working educational senses only, NOT verified morphological interpretations; no claim of immunity to harm.

jaap|jaap012.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the steady One, beyond being shaken.
jaap|jaap012.line01.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਅਡੋਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap012.line01.interpretiveCaution: For Nirdhute, the consulted commentary connects the word with movement. The draft therefore uses steadiness and removes the earlier added stain or impurity gloss. This remains an educational reading pending linguistic review.

jaap|jaap012.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One not confined to ordinary formed or created states; “Abhute” remains a working gloss.
jaap|jaap012.line02.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਸਿਰਜੀਆਂ ਰੂਪ-ਹੱਦਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ; “ਅਭੂਤੇ” ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap012.line02.interpretiveCaution: Nirdhute/Abhute/Aloke are lexically complex and could admit more than one qualified reading. Assumption is documented, not asserted as standard scholarly translation.

jaap|jaap012.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One not fully grasped by the visible worlds or ordinary perception.
jaap|jaap012.line03.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਦਿੱਸਦੇ ਲੋਕ ਜਾਂ ਆਮ ਇੰਦਰੀਆਂ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਫੜ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ।
jaap|jaap012.line03.interpretiveCaution: Nirdhute/Abhute/Aloke are lexically complex and could admit more than one qualified reading. Assumption is documented, not asserted as standard scholarly translation.

jaap|jaap012.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One not governed by grief or sorrow.
jaap|jaap012.line04.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਸੋਗ ਜਾਂ ਦੁੱਖ ਦੀ ਬੰਧਨ-ਹੱਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap012.line04.interpretiveCaution: Nirdhute/Abhute/Aloke are lexically complex and could admit more than one qualified reading. Assumption is documented, not asserted as standard scholarly translation.

jaap|jaap013.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the One beyond ordinary burning or affliction; the Sanskritic epithet needs source review.
jaap|jaap013.line01.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਆਮ ਤਾਪ ਜਾਂ ਕਲੇਸ਼ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ; ਸ਼ਬਦ-ਅਰਥ ਦੀ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਬਾਕੀ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap013.line01.interpretiveCaution: Nritape, Athape, Trimane and Nidhane require a specialist Braj/Sanskrit review; do not use the idea of a “treasury” as a promised financial reward.

jaap|jaap013.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One not placed or established by another force.
jaap|jaap013.line02.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੋਰ ਕੋਈ ਟਿਕਾਣਾ ਜਾਂ ਸਥਾਪਨਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap013.line02.interpretiveCaution: Nritape, Athape, Trimane and Nidhane require a specialist Braj/Sanskrit review; do not use the idea of a “treasury” as a promised financial reward.

jaap|jaap013.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One revered in every age and realm.
jaap|jaap013.line03.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਹਰ ਕਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਲੋਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੰਨਣਯੋਗ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap013.line03.interpretiveCaution: Trimane is an affirmative title of reverence. Consulted readings connect its threefold reference with past, present and future, or with the three worlds. This broad paraphrase leaves that distinction open; it does not invent a negative prefix meaning beyond categories.

jaap|jaap013.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One praised as an inexhaustible store of goodness and treasure.
jaap|jaap013.line04.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਣਾਂ ਤੇ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਅਥਾਹ ਖਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਕਿਹਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap013.line04.interpretiveCaution: Nritape, Athape, Trimane and Nidhane require a specialist Braj/Sanskrit review; do not use the idea of a “treasury” as a promised financial reward.

jaap|jaap014.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the One whose depth cannot be completely fathomed.
jaap|jaap014.line01.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਅਥਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਗਹਿਰਾਈ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਈ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ।
jaap|jaap014.line01.interpretiveCaution: This cluster has multiple difficult lexical items. Do not claim certain literal translations for Abahe, Tribarge or Asarge until qualified textual review.

jaap|jaap014.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One who remains unshaken.
jaap|jaap014.line02.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਅਡੋਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੇ ਹਿਲਾਇਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਿਲਦਾ।
jaap|jaap014.line02.interpretiveCaution: The same Abahe occurs in Chhand 6. This draft uses the same steadiness reading in both occurrences; it does not infer arms or bodily force from the spelling. Linguistic review remains open.

jaap|jaap014.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One expressed through the three qualities of nature.
jaap|jaap014.line03.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਕੁਦਰਤ ਦੇ ਤਿੰਨਾਂ ਗੁਣਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap014.line03.interpretiveCaution: This working reading of Tribarge follows the consulted Bhai Vir Singh-derived account of the three gunas: sattva, rajas and tamas. Other teaching traditions gloss the epithet differently. The exact compound remains under review; this line is not a settled definition of Divine nature.

jaap|jaap014.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One described as beyond created origin; Asarge needs a careful source-based gloss.
jaap|jaap014.line04.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਬਣਾਈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ; “ਅਸਰਗੇ” ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਜਾਂਚਯੋਗ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap014.line04.interpretiveCaution: This cluster has multiple difficult lexical items. Do not claim certain literal translations for Abahe, Tribarge or Asarge until qualified textual review.

jaap|jaap015.line01.simpleEn: I bow to the One whose joy is complete.
jaap|jaap015.line01.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap015.line01.interpretiveCaution: Prabhoge is read here through supreme enjoyment or bliss. Both language drafts now express that same working reading. This does not settle every sense of bhog or promise that a reader will always feel happy.

jaap|jaap015.line02.simpleEn: I bow to the One praised as rightly joined to all things and the source of harmony; Sujoge requires review.
jaap|jaap015.line02.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਹਰ ਸਹੀ ਜੋੜ ਤੇ ਸੰਬੰਧ ਦਾ ਮੂਲ ਹੈ; “ਸੁਜੋਗੇ” ਦੀ ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap015.line02.interpretiveCaution: Prabhoge/Sujoge require qualified interpretation, and the critique of colour is about Divine transcendence, never caste, race or human worth.

jaap|jaap015.line03.simpleEn: I bow to the One beyond limiting physical colour or appearance.
jaap|jaap015.line03.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਰੰਗ ਜਾਂ ਦਿੱਖ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੱਝਦਾ।
jaap|jaap015.line03.interpretiveCaution: Prabhoge/Sujoge require qualified interpretation, and the critique of colour is about Divine transcendence, never caste, race or human worth.

jaap|jaap015.line04.simpleEn: I bow to the One who cannot be broken, lost or diminished.
jaap|jaap015.line04.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜੋ ਅਭੰਗ ਹੈ, ਟੁੱਟਦਾ ਜਾਂ ਨਾਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ।
jaap|jaap015.line04.interpretiveCaution: Prabhoge/Sujoge require qualified interpretation, and the critique of colour is about Divine transcendence, never caste, race or human worth.

jaap|jaap016.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, beyond the full reach of thought and understanding.
jaap|jaap016.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸੋਚ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਕੜ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈਂ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap016.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਗੰਮੇ is treated as not fully reachable. This limits the knower’s grasp; in the selected reading of the next title, the Divine is also present throughout existence. Unfathomability need not mean absence.

jaap|jaap016.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, present throughout all existence.
jaap|jaap016.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੋਂਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਮਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈਂ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap016.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਰੰਮੇ is read here as pervading, following Neki. Sant Seva Singh emphasises beauty, while the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account emphasises bliss. These are distinct interpretive possibilities; the main explanation selects one rather than claiming they are identical.

jaap|jaap016.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the sustaining support of the waters.
jaap|jaap016.line03.simplePa: ਜਲ ਨੂੰ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap016.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਜਲ is water. The support-reading follows the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account; Neki and Sant Seva Singh instead use an ocean-image. The compound is not read here through ਜਾਲ, a net. Its relation to ਨਿਰਾਸਰੇ gives the pair its teaching focus.

jaap|jaap016.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose existence depends on no other support.
jaap|jaap016.line04.simplePa: ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਹੋਂਦ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਦੇ ਆਸਰੇ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap016.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਨਿਰਾਸਰੇ names freedom from dependence. After ਜਲਾਸਰੇ, it turns attention from what is supported to the One who needs no external support. Here the word does not mean dejected or hopeless.

jaap|jaap017.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, beyond every division of caste.
jaap|jaap017.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤ ਦੀ ਹਰ ਵੰਡ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈਂ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap017.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਜਾਤੇ is read through caste here, following Neki and Sant Seva Singh and its pairing with ਅਪਾਤੇ. The Bhai Vir Singh-derived rendering instead takes it as unborn. The draft keeps that lexical alternative open.

jaap|jaap017.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, not confined to any lineage or clan.
jaap|jaap017.line02.simplePa: ਕਿਸੇ ਗੋਤ ਜਾਂ ਖ਼ਾਨਦਾਨ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾ ਬੱਝਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap017.line02.interpretiveCaution: The lineage reading connects ਅਪਾਤੇ with ਪਾਤਿ and the ਜਾਤਿ/ਪਾਤਿ pair in Chhand 1. Another consulted reading is not falling, or unfailing. Clan or lineage is the selected sense; the source word is not respelled to settle the difference.

jaap|jaap017.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, whom no single creed can contain.
jaap|jaap017.line03.simplePa: ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਇੱਕ ਮਜ਼ਹਬ ਆਪਣੀ ਹੱਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੰਨ੍ਹ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap017.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅਮਜਬੇ draws on ਮਜ਼ਹਬ, a religious way or creed, with a negative prefix. The title denies confinement of the Divine. It does not ask the reader to abandon faith or belittle another community.

jaap|jaap017.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the wondrous One.
jaap|jaap017.line04.simplePa: ਅਸਚਰਜ ਸਰੂਪ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap017.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਜਬੇ is affirmative wonder. After three titles that deny fixed classifications, the ending turns from what cannot contain the One toward reverent astonishment. The changed emphasis matters even within the repeated salutation.

jaap|jaap018.line01.simpleEn: I bow in reverence to You, whom no country or place can enclose.
jaap|jaap018.line01.simplePa: ਦੇਸ ਜਾਂ ਥਾਂ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap018.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਦੇਸੰ supplies the salutation while ਅਦੇਸੇ can describe freedom from locality. The Bhai Vir Singh-derived note also permits repeated salutation. The selected place-related reading fits the sequence continued by ਨ੍ਰਿਧਾਮੇ.

jaap|jaap018.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, not restricted to any outward dress or disguise.
jaap|jaap018.line02.simplePa: ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਭੇਖ ਜਾਂ ਬਾਹਰਲੀ ਦਿੱਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾ ਬੱਝਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap018.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭੇਸੇ returns to ਭੇਖ/ਭੇਸ, an outer guise. The description concerns the limits of assigning an appearance to the Divine. Religious clothing worn by people is a separate matter from this epithet.

jaap|jaap018.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, beyond confinement in any dwelling.
jaap|jaap018.line03.simplePa: ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਾ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap018.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਨ੍ਰਿਧਾਮੇ negates a fixed ਧਾਮ, abode. Read with the opening line, it extends the scale from country to dwelling. The emphasis is on the One’s freedom from a containing location.

jaap|jaap018.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, untouched by the hold of Maya.
jaap|jaap018.line04.simplePa: ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਂ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap018.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਨ੍ਰਿਬਾਮੇ is read here as freedom from Maya, following Sant Seva Singh. Neki reads it through the absence of a spouse; SikhTranslations also records freedom from enmity. The Maya sense is a selected interpretation, not a settled derivation.

jaap|jaap019.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, who bring all created things to their end.
jaap|jaap019.line01.simplePa: ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap019.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਕਾਲੇ is read in its time, death and ending range, following Neki and Sant Seva Singh. The Bhai Vir Singh-derived account reads Chhand 19 as enduring through all times. The identical words recur in Chhand 20, line 3; this draft keeps their main explanation consistent.

jaap|jaap019.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose compassion reaches all.
jaap|jaap019.line02.simplePa: ਸਭ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap019.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ gives compassion its universal reach. Coming after ਕਾਲੇ, ਦਿਆਲੇ keeps the stanza’s language of ending beside mercy. The repeated address does not divide these titles between rival powers.

jaap|jaap019.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, present in every form.
jaap|jaap019.line03.simplePa: ਸਭ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap019.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਰੂਪੇ is an affirmative title after earlier descriptions of the formless One. This working paraphrase speaks of presence throughout forms, without making any one visible image an exhaustive description.

jaap|jaap019.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, sovereign over all.
jaap|jaap019.line04.simplePa: ਸਭ ਦੇ ਮਾਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap019.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਭੂਪੇ brings the image of a ruler; ਸਰਬ widens it to all. Read with universal compassion in line 2, the title describes sovereignty without reducing the One to a particular earthly monarch.

jaap|jaap020.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, who dissolve all that has been formed.
jaap|jaap020.line01.simplePa: ਸਾਰੀ ਬਣੀ ਹੋਈ ਰਚਨਾ ਨੂੰ ਲੀਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap020.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਖਾਪੇ has the sense of bringing to an end or consuming. Its immediate pairing with ਥਾਪੇ makes dissolution and establishment complementary titles. Dissolving is a devotional working rendering here, not a proposed physical mechanism.

jaap|jaap020.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, who bring all into being and establish it.
jaap|jaap020.line02.simplePa: ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਹੋਂਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਆ ਕੇ ਟਿਕਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap020.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਥਾਪੇ concerns setting up or establishing. The paraphrase keeps that action visible: the One is addressed in relation to things coming to stand in existence, alongside their passing away in the preceding line.

jaap|jaap020.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, who bring all created things to their end.
jaap|jaap020.line03.simplePa: ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap020.line03.interpretiveCaution: The source repeats Chhand 19, line 1 exactly. Here ਕਾਲੇ stands beside ਪਾਲੇ, placing ending alongside nurture. The death or ending sense is selected consistently; an all-times reading is retained in the source comparison notes.

jaap|jaap020.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, who nourish and sustain all.
jaap|jaap020.line04.simplePa: ਸਭ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap020.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਪਾਲੇ denotes caring for or sustaining. It closes the sequence on nurture, after the preceding titles have included both establishment and ending. The repeated ਸਰਬ extends this care to all.

jaap|jaap021.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, radiant with Divine light.
jaap|jaap021.line01.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਸਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap021.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਦੇਵੈ is read through radiance, as in Sant Seva Singh and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account. Neki instead stresses worship-worthiness. Divine light is a devotional description here, not a defined visible shape or colour.

jaap|jaap021.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose full mystery cannot be fathomed.
jaap|jaap021.line02.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ, ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap021.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭੇਵੈ is treated here as unfathomable, following the Bhai Vir Singh-derived rendering. Neki’s no-secret wording and Sant Seva Singh’s ਭੇਦ ਰਹਿਤ point toward other readings. The main sentence does not claim to resolve them.

jaap|jaap021.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose being does not begin with birth.
jaap|jaap021.line03.simplePa: ਉਸ ਅਜਨਮੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਹੋਂਦ ਜਨਮ ਨਾਲ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ।
jaap|jaap021.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅਜਨਮੇ directly names absence of birth. Keep it distinct from the disputed next epithet; this line should not be rewritten to make a single theory of the pair appear certain.

jaap|jaap021.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the One of wondrous beauty.
jaap|jaap021.line04.simplePa: ਅਸਚਰਜ ਸੁੰਦਰਤਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap021.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਸੁਬਨਮੇ is provisionally read through beauty or splendour, following Neki; the Bhai Vir Singh-derived explanation stresses reverence. Sant Seva Singh instead uses the world-as-offspring image. The compound remains unresolved and is not derived here from good name.

jaap|jaap022.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose presence reaches everywhere.
jaap|jaap022.line01.simplePa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap022.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਗਉਨੇ carries the image of movement or going. With ਸਰਬ, it is read as presence extending everywhere. The image need not give the Divine a body that must travel to gain access to each place.

jaap|jaap022.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, dwelling throughout all worlds and places.
jaap|jaap022.line02.simplePa: ਸਭ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap022.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਭਉਨੇ is connected in the consulted readings with ਭਵਨ, a dwelling or realm. After the movement-image of ਗਉਨੇ, it offers the complementary image of abiding presence throughout the worlds.

jaap|jaap022.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, expressed in every colour and form.
jaap|jaap022.line03.simplePa: ਸਭ ਰੰਗਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap022.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਰੰਗੇ evokes colours and diverse appearances. The earlier ਅਰੰਗੇ in Chhand 15 denies a limiting colour; ਸਰਬ ਰੰਗੇ expands the address to every colour. The pairing creates a poetic contrast rather than a ranking of appearances.

jaap|jaap022.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, who can bring every created form to an end.
jaap|jaap022.line04.simplePa: ਹਰ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਹੋਏ ਰੂਪ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap022.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਭੰਗੇ names breaking up or dissolution. Following the abundance of forms in ਰੰਗੇ, the ending prevents their variety from becoming a claim that any particular form lasts forever.

jaap|jaap023.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, the One before whom even death has no final power.
jaap|jaap023.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਮੌਤ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਅੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਵੱਸ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap023.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਕਾਲ ਕਾਲੇ intensifies the language of death and time: even their power is subject to the Divine. It praises the One addressed; it does not promise bodily immortality to a reader.

jaap|jaap023.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose nature is compassionate and merciful.
jaap|jaap023.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਅਤੇ ਰਹਿਮ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap023.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਦਿਆਲੇ brings compassion immediately beside the strong death imagery. The two descriptions address the same One, so power should be read together with mercy.

jaap|jaap023.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose reality no description can fully contain.
jaap|jaap023.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਕੋਈ ਵਰਣਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਰੂਪ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਿਆਨ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap023.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅਬਰਨੇ is read here as beyond complete description, following the Rampur Khera and Neki readings. The Bhai Vir Singh commentary also gives the colourless reading: without a defining colour. The lexical choice remains open to review.

jaap|jaap023.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the deathless One whose being does not perish.
jaap|jaap023.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਂਦ ਨਾਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap023.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਮਰਨੇ names the deathless Divine. Read it with the opening ਕਾਲ ਕਾਲੇ, while keeping the difference between a Divine attribute and the mortal condition of human beings.

jaap|jaap024.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, the ageless One whom growing old cannot diminish.
jaap|jaap024.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਬੁਢਾਪਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਂਦ ਨੂੰ ਘਟਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦਾ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap024.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਜਰਾਰੰ is provisionally read as beyond aging, supported by Neki and Narain Singh. Sant Sewa Singh’s Rampur Khera steek instead reads it as mighty or powerful. The draft preserves that alternative rather than claiming one settled derivation.

jaap|jaap024.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the Creator through whom things come into being.
jaap|jaap024.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਰਚਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap024.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰੰ is read as Creator here, as in Narain Singh, Neki and the Bhai Vir Singh commentary. The Rampur Khera steek reads it as the One who cuts karmic bonds. These are distinct readings; this draft does not adjudicate their derivation.

jaap|jaap024.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, through whose power the world’s many activities unfold.
jaap|jaap024.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਕਾਰ-ਵਿਹਾਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੱਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਚੱਲਦੇ ਹਨ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap024.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਧੰਧੇ concerns all the world’s activities and engagements. The next line is necessary to the sense: involvement in their unfolding is placed beside freedom from their bonds.

jaap|jaap024.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, who remain free from the bonds of all those activities.
jaap|jaap024.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਕਾਰ-ਵਿਹਾਰਾਂ ਦੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਦੇ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap024.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਬੰਧੇ supplies the unbound quality. The frozen source joins ਨਮੋਸਤ; the draft does not silently change its spacing or treat an alternative parsing as a corrected scripture text.

jaap|jaap025.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, who are not bound by the limits of family or kinship.
jaap|jaap025.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਾਕ-ਸੰਬੰਧਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਹੱਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੱਝਦਾ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap025.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਨ੍ਰਿਸਾਕੇ negates limiting kinship ties. The following merciful and generous epithets rule out reading this simply as coldness or indifference to others.

jaap|jaap025.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, who are free from fear of any other power.
jaap|jaap025.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਦੀ ਤਾਕਤ ਤੋਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਡਰਦਾ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap025.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਨ੍ਰਿਬਾਕੇ is read as fearless, with ਬਾਕ carrying the sense of fear. It is a different word from ਨ੍ਰਿਬਾਮੇ in Chhand 18; their similar sounds do not make their meanings interchangeable.

jaap|jaap025.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the merciful One who responds with compassion.
jaap|jaap025.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਰਹਿਮ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap025.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਰਹੀਮੇ carries the quality of mercy. Keep its sense distinct but connected to the generosity named by ਕਰੀਮੇ in the next line.

jaap|jaap025.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the generous One, abundant in giving and grace.
jaap|jaap025.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਉਦਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap025.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਕਰੀਮੇ is read here through generosity and gracious giving. The praise does not specify a particular material gift or make Divine generosity a transaction.

jaap|jaap026.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose being has no end or enclosing boundary.
jaap|jaap026.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਂਦ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤ ਜਾਂ ਘੇਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap026.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਨੰਤੇ praises endlessness. This is a devotional recognition of the limits of measurement, not a count or a physical size.

jaap|jaap026.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose greatness surpasses every comparison.
jaap|jaap026.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਮਹਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap026.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਮਹੰਤੇ expresses supreme greatness here. It is not being used as the later institutional title for the head of a religious establishment.

jaap|jaap026.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, praised as love itself.
jaap|jaap026.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ-ਸਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap026.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਰਾਗੇ is read in the sense of love or affection, supported by the commentaries and the Mahan Kosh ਰਾਗ entry. The familiar musical sense of raag should not automatically replace that contextual reading.

jaap|jaap026.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, praised as the fullness of blessedness and auspiciousness.
jaap|jaap026.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸੁਹਾਗ-ਭਾਗ ਅਤੇ ਮੰਗਲ ਦੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap026.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਸੁਹਾਗੇ is provisionally read through blessed fortune or auspiciousness. Other explanations bring out glory or the beloved/spouse relationship. Such imagery does not rank people by marriage, gender or a spouse’s survival.

jaap|jaap027.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, who bring all created forms to their end.
jaap|jaap027.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਾਰੇ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਹੋਏ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਵੱਸ ਹੈ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap027.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਸੋਖੰ carries drying up, absorbing or dissolving, read here as bringing forms to an end. It must not be silently read as ਸੁਖ, happiness. The sustaining ਪੋਖੰ follows immediately.

jaap|jaap027.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, who nourish and sustain all.
jaap|jaap027.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਅਤੇ ਪੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap027.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਪੋਖੰ contributes nourishment and maintenance. It answers the dissolving sense of ਸੋਖੰ; the rhyme joins contrasting activities rather than giving the two words the same meaning.

jaap|jaap027.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the Creator of all that exists.
jaap|jaap027.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap027.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਕਰਤਾ is the creative agent. With ਸਰਬ, the praise gives this action universal scope, rather than restricting it to one community or place.

jaap|jaap027.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, through whose power all created forms are dissolved.
jaap|jaap027.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਾਰੇ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਰੂਪ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੱਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਟ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap027.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਹਰਤਾ has the sense of removing or bringing to an end, paired here with ਕਰਤਾ. It is not an instruction for a reader to destroy anything.

jaap|jaap028.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, praised as the Yogi above all yogis.
jaap|jaap028.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਜੋਗੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap028.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਜੋਗ ਜੋਗੇ intensifies the language of spiritual union and yogic detachment. It praises the Divine as supreme; it is not a lesson in physical yoga postures or a ranking of living teachers.

jaap|jaap028.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, praised as the enjoyer above all enjoyers.
jaap|jaap028.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚੇ ਭੋਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap028.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ gives a supreme-enjoyer reading in the Rampur Khera steek; the Bhai Vir Singh commentary brings out fullness of bliss. Both belong beside ਜੋਗ ਜੋਗੇ, without making indulgence a command for the reader.

jaap|jaap028.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose compassion embraces all.
jaap|jaap028.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap028.line03.interpretiveCaution: The frozen line reads ਸਰਬ ਦਿਆਲੇ, so this explanation concerns compassion toward all. A different word displayed by one commentary website is not imported into the original or used as this line’s anchor.

jaap|jaap028.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, who sustain and care for all.
jaap|jaap028.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap028.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਪਾਲੇ joins universal care to the preceding universal compassion. It completes the stanza’s praise of the same One addressed through both ਜੋਗ and ਭੋਗ.

jaap|jaap029.line01.simpleEn: You are formless, not contained within a body or visible outline.
jaap|jaap029.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੇਹ ਜਾਂ ਦਿੱਸਦੇ ਆਕਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap029.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਰੂਪ denies a defining material form. The preceding ਚਾਚਰੀ ਛੰਦ heading introduces a new metre, and the repeated ਹੈਂ now makes the devotional address directly “You are”.

jaap|jaap029.line02.simpleEn: You are incomparable; no likeness can fully match You.
